hypothesis: A tuned HistGradientBoostingClassifier (learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=500, early_stopping=True, n_iter_no_change=20, validation_fraction=0.1) will beat the Random Forest baseline, unlike the earlier untuned HGB run that underperformed.
verdict: Did not beat baseline: auc_roc 0.618560 vs 0.736144 (-0.117583, about 16% relative). A secondary experiment with deeper trees (max_leaf_nodes=63, max_depth=10) performed even worse (auc_roc 0.578), suggesting HGB overfits or underfits this feature set (heavy on one-hot categoricals plus leave-one-out target-encoded features) regardless of tuning, not just an undertraining issue.
